description: Count pin for scripts/evaluate_detectors.py --expect on seed.json, recorded in E73 (x86_64 cloud CPU). A detector fails when it hits fewer present labels, violates more absent labels, confuses more objects or changes how many checks it can score. It is a wiring and label-mapping regression check on the runner CPU, not Frame evidence and not a basis for choosing a detector. Counts, not scores, are pinned, so CPU floating-point differences cannot move it. Update it only with the manifest, in a reviewed change that explains the new counts.
